key_insight: A coupled property-prediction and physics-filtering workflow can rank unexplored ionic liquids more reliably by accounting for uncertainty in sparse, noisy, out-of-distribution data.
engineering_relevance: This enables faster, more trustworthy screening of synthesizable ionic liquids for CO2 capture by prioritizing candidates with favorable trade-offs in solubility, viscosity, and working capacity.
method: Process sparse and uneven ionic-liquid data for deep learning property prediction.
Estimate prediction uncertainty to support robust out-of-distribution screening and ranking.
Apply physics-based calculations and Pareto selection to filter candidates for CO2 capture.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports demonstration on novel ionic liquids for flue-gas CO2 capture, with candidate selection based on predicted CO2 solubility, viscosity, and working capacity.
watch_item: Performance may still be sensitive to data sparsity and measurement noise, so uncertainty estimates and rankings should be validated carefully before experimental follow-up.
paper_title: Comprehensive Workflow for Uncertainty-Aware Ionic Liquid Solvent Discovery
